Subject: Post-call: next steps + rotating demo slots (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Liam, Sophie, Kenji —

Thanks again for hopping on the discovery call this morning. Really helpful to understand FinWave and MediaCorp's latency and compliance priorities, and Kenji, great context on APAC regulatory constraints.

Next step: we'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive / demo with our infra engineers to walk through integration patterns, auth/KMS options, and a quick perf sketch for your typical request mix. I want to be mindful of everyone’s timezones, so below are a few rotating slot proposals so the recurring meeting gives fair coverage for US / EU / APAC participants over successive weeks. Please pick the slot(s) that work best or suggest alternatives: 

Option A (rotating):
- Week 1: 08:00 PT / 16:00 CET / 00:00 JST
- Week 2: 10:00 PT / 18:00 CET / 02:00 JST
- Week 3: 07:00 PT / 15:00 CET / 23:00 JST

Option B (one-time deep dive, overlap):
- Thu 12 Mar — 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET / 01:00 JST (90 min)

Option C (APAC-friendly):
- Fri 13 Mar — 17:00 PT / 01:00 CET (next day) / 09:00 JST (next day)

If you prefer, we can also do a single session and record for those who can't attend; the rotating option helps ensure someone on your side gets a reasonable local hour at least once in three weeks.

I've attached the discovery notes and a short Redwood one-pager for context. If you confirm preferred option(s), I'll lock the invite and add the demo runbook and pre-req checklist.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
